text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with an update on the progress of TO Live's Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Access Staff Committee which includes introducing two new platforms being offered to TO Live employees.

TO Live - Environmental, Social and Governance Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Receive the report (March 24, 2023) from the President and Chief Executive Office, TO Live for information.
